title: AI Guidance Suite
flavorText: A dedicated heuristic processing node designed to govern autonomous systems.
rulesText: Apply +1 to missile or drone weapon attacks.

title: AI-Targeting Turrets
flavorText: Predictive fire-control meshes split salvos across several targets at once.
rulesText: Your weapons gain Multi-Shot. You may split each weapon's dice among different targets.

title: Beam Projector
flavorText: A singularity-tuned emitter that strikes across sector boundaries.
rulesText: Tactical attack: one shot at an opposing ship in an adjacent sector. No combat rounds, return fire, retreat, or Spoils of War.

title: Compressor
flavorText: Magnetic rails crush slugs until the breech screams.
rulesText: If you roll 1 or more natural 1, take 1 damage. Each natural 6 hits for 2 damage.

title: Concussion
flavorText: Shaped charges meant to punch through layered hull lattice.
rulesText: On 1 or more hits, if the target ship has 3 or more hull, apply 1 additional hit.

title: Disrupter Lance
flavorText: Phase shear tuned to rip shield harmonics apart.

title: Drone Hangar
flavorText: Rapid-deployment bays for escort drones that paint targets for the main battery.
rulesText: On an attack action: spend 1 TC to deploy a drone. It adds +1 to your attack rolls until combat ends, then is discarded.

title: Energy Focus Lens
flavorText: Tunable optics that coax more coherent bursts from energy emitters.

title: Flak Scattergun
flavorText: A cloud of flechettes that only connect when fate swings true.
rulesText: This gun only ever hits on a natural 6, regardless of any combat bonuses.

title: Gauss Accelerator
flavorText: Hypervelocity slugs that punish a glancing strike.
rulesText: If this weapon does exactly one hit, apply one damage cube (the defender cannot discard a component).

title: Heavy Plasma Cannon
flavorText: Overfed magnetic bottles vent star-hot plasma in heavy bolts.

title: Interceptor Rig
flavorText: Escort drones that leap to defence.
rulesText: When attacked by a mass accelerator, missile, or drone weapon, after the attack roll, make a free 1-die attack at 5+ against the attacker.

title: Laser Cannon
flavorText: A stock energy cannon every yard can mount without fuss.

title: Mass Targeting Array
flavorText: Fire-control servos tuned for slug-throwers and drivers.
rulesText: Apply +1 to mass accelerator weapon attacks.

title: Minigun
flavorText: A compact rotary cannon for sustained suppressive fire.

title: Nanite Swarm
flavorText: Grey-goo payloads that borrow your crew's focus for one decisive pass.
rulesText: You may exhaust action tokens to increase the accuracy of this weapon by +1 for each token exhausted.

title: Ram-Loader
flavorText: Pneumatic feeds that shove extra mass rounds into the line.
rulesText: Mass accelerator weapons on this ship get +1 die and +1 to hit. If any mass attack die is a natural 1, take 1 damage once per attack action.

title: Railgun
flavorText: Sequential rail pairs that only find slow prey.
rulesText: Apply an additional −1 to hit for each speed of the target ship. Will still hit on the roll of 6.

title: Side-Mounted Laser
flavorText: A sponson emitter for disciplined, low-footprint energy fire.

title: Micro-Missile Array
flavorText: Racks of micro-warheads that ripple across a target's face.

title: The Apocalypse
flavorText: A colossal kinetic launcher that hurls world-ending mass payloads across the void.

title: Thermal Pyre
flavorText: Thermal lances that leave targets sluggish in your wake.
rulesText: Any ship damaged by this weapon has its speed reduced by 1 for the remainder of the round.

title: Torpedo Bay
flavorText: Cluster dispensers sized for opportunistic cargo strikes.
rulesText: On each hit, spend 1 H3 to force the target to remove 1 resource (other than void matter) from their cargo hold.

title: Void-Core Overdrive
flavorText: A void-tapped reactor that trades hull integrity for overwhelming salvos.
rulesText: Spend 1 H3 when using a weapon to double that weapon's dice for that attack. After the action, this ship takes 1 damage.
